fit.period: 2024 all valid hourly forecasts whose label end is strictly before2025-01-01
fit.method: One regularized linear least-squares fit on labels clipped[-3,3], raw labels retained. A=X.T*X+diag(1,100,100,100,100,100,100,100,100); initial w=solve(A,X.T*y), P=inverse(A). No hyperparameter/model/feature search.
fit.onnx: Fresh float32 MatMul(features[1,9],dynamic weights[9,1])->prediction[1,1], IR8/opset17. Normalization and linear state are owned by producer/EA; graph inference used for both roles.

online.initial: Same frozen2024 w/P/normalization. Begin2025with empty pending queue; no2024late label state adopted.
online.update: At every valid new H1 forecast consume pending complete labels only if end<current forecast-barT, oldest first. k=P*x/(1+x.T*P*x); w=w+k*(clip(y,-3,3)-w.T*x); P=P-k*(x.T*P). Forgetting factor1.0, no resets or tuning. Record stored-entry prediction loss separately from update-time residual.
online.causality: Store x/prediction/label-window bound at prediction. No same-hour-end label benefits that forecast, no candidate trade outcome needed. Online state does not modify other components or risk. Missing inference records a fault and abstains this new Cross decision; incomplete labels never erase forecasts.

signal.hurdle: Forecast price move=last completed US100 H1 close*expm1(rawprediction*2*prior120US100SD). Trade sign only if absolute forecast move exceeds2*max(0.01,final completed M1 spread*0.01); otherwise abstain. This uses past information only. Original native quote/session/protection/admission still applies.
signal.reference: Same daily opportunities with exact original relative-z direction and abs(z)>=0.5 threshold.
signal.quote_selection: For each active intent score direction*(future final bid close-entry reference bid close)-2*max(0.01,past spread*0.01,future final spread*0.01), divided by the entry reference close. Report all results in quote basis points, never dollars, compounded wealth or native DD. This is an approximate spread charge; no margin, stop, tick-order fill, financing or portfolio admission is simulated.
